assets.title: Panda — soft fur
assets.description: Cleaner face and a soft rendered coat with the green shoulder dragon. Four gentle motions: idle, look around, head tilt and tail lift/dip. Interactive 3D uses a lighter, less plush coat; not a Muse-equivalent model.

assets.title: Dragon — smoother finish
assets.description: Bounded local surface refinement of the same Meshy source. Same 4K textures and four motions. No Muse-parity or Weft-physics claim.
